content: I was extremely disappointed in the quality of this foam mattress. After only a few weeks of use, it began to sag in the middle, causing me to constantly roll into the uncomfortable dip. The foam felt cheap and easily compressible, providing little support for my back. I woke up every morning with aches and pains that I never experienced with my old mattress. The foam also retained heat and made me sweat throughout the night, resulting in poor sleep quality. The chemical smell that emitted from the mattress was overpowering and took weeks to dissipate. I reached out to customer service for a refund or replacement and was met with slow response times and unhelpful representatives. Overall, I would not recommend this foam mattress to anyone looking for a comfortable and supportive sleeping surface.
